description: cfd_2d_6dof_fish_inext with the fluid-momentum coupling (X 198 1) instead of the added-mass stabilisation (X 197): the rigid-body motion fitted to the predicted velocity of each stage in the hull region (weights rho (2H - 1) dV, the deformation velocity of the RK combination removed) gives the loads of the body.
covers: sixdof_obj_cfd::momentum_fit (normal equations of the rigid fit, the deformation velocity at t^n and t^(s-1))
sixdof_obj_cfd::momentum_loads (TVD RK3 stage weights, the gyroscopic part of dh)
X 198 turns the added-mass stabilisation off
